scope: Short real online overte_hub with isolated native guest workers; read-only and muted. FST graph memo and current renderer capability caches enabled; shader/texture-preparation experiments off.
limits: Different live domain snapshots; these cohorts do not establish an isolated causal speedup.
Phase counts are invocations; overlapping phase totals are not elapsed time or unique GPU uploads.
The single-session diagnostic does not verify reconnect and is not strict fluid acceptance.
Both strict cohorts complete functional native movement and reconnect, but fail the unchanged fluid acceptance.
Firefox and Chromium retain their actual initial device density; drawing buffers differ.
